description: Supabase Data REST API and Management API for Postgres-backed projects, plus an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Data API sits behind a gateway with key-auth, using project API keys from dashboard settings; Management API uses a personal access token sent as Bearer.
gate_detail: Developers get project API keys from dashboard settings and a Management API access token from account tokens page. No plan requirement stated for these; some MCP branching tools need a paid plan. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Auto-generated PostgREST REST API over each project's database, a Management API for organizations and projects, a GraphQL API listed in docs, and client libraries.
mcp_notes: Supabase documents its own Supabase MCP Server for AI tools on supabase.com; hosted connection URL not stated in the sources.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate for API access stated; role scoping and MCP branching need paid plans.

evidence.quote: It exposes everything you need from a CRUD API at the URL `https://<project_ref>.supabase.co/rest/v1/`.
provisioned behind an API gateway with key-auth enabled.
You can find the API Keys in the [**Settings > API Keys**](https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/settings/api-keys/) section of the Dashboard.

uncertainties: Free-tier versus paid-plan requirements for API keys are not stated.
MCP server URL is not given in the sources.
Webhooks and sandbox are not covered by the sources.
